description: Prebuilt law library for Canon, one file per jurisdiction. law-federal.db: the Internal Revenue Code (26 U.S.C., through Public Law 119-73) and the Treasury regulations (26 CFR Parts 1 and 301, eCFR as of 2025-12-31). law-ca.db: California's Revenue and Taxation Code (Division 2: the franchise and income tax laws, as of 2026-11-22). FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, and each document's source files.
_notes: GitHub Release assets (law-v3 tag), one per jurisdiction: `law fetch` installs each to canon/.data/law/<jurisdiction>.db (federal.db, ca.db), and `law fetch --jurisdiction CA` installs one. A new state is one more entry; a state can be published again without the federal file. Optional: nothing needs the law until an agent or a person asks for it. Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in each file's ref_meta).
